definitions.budget_cutoff: Start < budget; complete <= budget. Crossing module attempted but conservative outcomes unavailable
definitions.censored_pass: Exclude ordering if original patched process costs are truncated or module processes not reached; individual IDs not_reached after a measured crash do not censor process cost
definitions.censoring: Null time means no regression at that bound within the budget; full unbudgeted bounds also recorded
definitions.changed_name: Exact basename after removing test_ prefix or _test suffix; frozen SCG mapping path/base_path only
definitions.collection_variant: Add each module collection-group duration; collection wall overhead remains separately reported
definitions.confirmation_cost: Isolated patched confirmations reported separately; not part of the initial patched pass
definitions.missing_changed_paths: Exclude ordering rather than reconstruct changed modules from patches
definitions.module_cost: All end-event durations in the initial patched pass, including retry, fallback and split-parent processes
definitions.nonbinding: Non-informative; if all seven budgets are nonbinding, overall evidence verdict is inconclusive
definitions.not_launched: No recorded module process means zero observed process cost; not a per-test runtime estimate
definitions.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; censored values sort after finite values; censored upper interpolation returns null
definitions.reading_counts: 90% threshold evaluated with integer counts; no aggregate regression rate reported
definitions.reading_median: Median across seven task TTFs; compare strictly against q25 of 20 per-seed task medians
definitions.share_not_reached: Frozen V2 IDs with no recorded runnable module started / frozen V2 size; partially reached expanded families counted separately
definitions.source_order: First appearance through the frozen V2 list, with recorded native runnable module expansions in their recorded order
definitions.tier_tie: Prefer before when both before and after exactly match; record both exact matches
